key_terms_explained.BAA: Bangsamoro Autonomy Act - a regional law passed by the Bangsamoro Parliament, applying inside BARMM alongside national laws.
key_terms_explained.IRR: Implementing Rules and Regulations - the ministry-issued 'how-to' that turns a law's text into procedures; many laws only bite once the IRR is out.
key_terms_explained.GAA: General Appropriations Act - the annual budget law deciding how much each ministry and program gets.

benefits.headline: Protection and support for Bangsamoro OFWs and their families.

direct_benefits.benefit: Institutional protection and welfare standards for overseas workers
direct_benefits.how_to_access: Through MOLE-BARMM and its overseas-employment programs

direct_benefits.benefit: Family support services while the worker is abroad

indirect_benefits: Cleaner deployment reduces trafficking and abuse
limitations: Overseas enforcement still relies on national agencies (DMW/OWWA) - this law adds the regional layer
